| Option | Default | What images carry | Kinds an image accepts only with it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chalkos.kubernetes.bgp.enable` | `true` | FRR, which runs BGP and BFD | `BGPPeer`, `BGPSpeaker` |
| `chalkos.kubernetes.ceph.enable` | `true` | the `rbd`, `ceph` and `nbd` kernel modules, loaded at boot, and LVM for Rook's OSDs | none |
| `chalkos.kubernetes.kubevirt.enable` | `true` | the kernel modules of KubeVirt's virtual machines, KVM, vhost, VFIO and UIO, loaded on demand | none |
| `chalkos.kubernetes.longhorn.enable` | `false` | what Longhorn runs on the host: iscsid and iscsiadm, the NFS client, the `iscsi_tcp` and `dm_crypt` kernel modules, loaded at boot, and links for `iscsiadm`, `fstrim`, `cryptsetup`, `dmsetup` and `mount` in `/usr/bin` and `/usr/sbin` | none |
| `chalkos.kubernetes.nvidia.enable` | `false` | NVIDIA's GPU driver, loaded at boot, with its firmware, containerd's runtime handler `nvidia`, a CDI specification of the node's GPUs written at boot and the driver's programs and libraries in `/usr/local/nvidia`, for NVIDIA's GPU operator with the driver and the toolkit on the host. The driver is unfree: the image's nixpkgs must allow it | none |
| `chalkos.kubernetes.registry.enable` | `true` | chalkos-registry, the cluster registry | `ClusterRegistry` |
